Nadia (Docs): Quick sync- I want to add a compact migration note and two tiny examples (Node + Py) for Optimize: microBatch + kvPrefetch + q4 profile. Planning to land under examples/optimize/shortseq-migration.md. Thoughts?

Theo (Eng SDK): Love it. Use the canonical param names microBatch, kvPrefetch, quantProfile. For Node show promise-style and for Py show streaming example.

Priya (ML): Add a one-line compatibility caveat: q4 profiles are best on A100/T4; other GPUs may fall back or require offload. Also include a small quant_profile YAML sample.

Nadia (Docs): Draft Node snippet (first pass):
```js
const { OptimizeClient } = require('@redwood/optimize-client');
const c = new OptimizeClient();
const r = await c.generate({ model: 'rwkv-7b', prompt: 'Short summary', maxTokens: 48, microBatch: 4, kvPrefetch: true, quantProfile: 'q4_0' });
console.log(r.text);
```

Theo (Eng SDK): One small rename: r.text is correct. For snippet-tests in CI, prefer top-level require name exactly as used in test env (@redwood/optimize-client). Also add minimal error handling to avoid noisy test failures.

Nadia (Docs): Updated. Adding Py streaming snippet too:
```python
from redwood.optimize import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
for chunk in c.stream(model='rwkv-7b', prompt='Continue', micro_batch=2, kv_prefetch=True, quant_profile='q4_0'):
    print(chunk.text)
```

Priya (ML): YAML for quant profile to paste:
```yaml
name: q4_0
bits: 4
channelwise: true
notes: "Prefer A100/T4; fallback to fp16/offload if unsupported"
```

Nadia (Docs): CI please run checks @ci-bot - snippet-tests + link-check.

ci-bot: starting checks for branch docs/optimize/shortseq-migration - snippet-tests failed: examples/optimize/shortseq-migration.md line 12 - ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood.optimize' in test harness.

Theo (Eng SDK): Test harness uses package name exactly '@redwood/optimize-client' for JS and import path 'redwood.optimize_client' in Python tests. Change imports to match or add alias in test matrix.

Nadia (Docs): Adjusted imports to match test env, added migration anchor explaining old names (batchSize -> microBatch, prefetchKv -> kvPrefetch). Fixed a broken link to /optimize/quant-profiles. Pushing final commit.

ci-bot: rerunning - all checks passed. MD-lint warns about long line; shortened. link-check OK. Merging. :merged:

Nadia (Docs): Published prod URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/shortseq-migration - added to release notes under "Optimize toolkit: short-sequence examples & migration". Closing thread, thanks! :sparkles:
